title: equisdots plugin manifest
description: Normative schema for a plugin's plugin.json.

id.description: Stable slug; used in settings keys, folder names and the CLI.

compat.description: Version ranges the plugin requires. Absent = no constraint. Evaluated by plugin-api/scripts/plugins_compat.sh and lib/semver.lua.

api.description: Capabilities the plugin requests from the shell host API.

defaults.description: Path (repo-relative) to a settings fragment the plugin owns (e.g. "defaults.json" = {"<scope>": {...}}). dots merges it into settings.json on install; the user's values win. Keeps the plugin self-contained (code + UI + defaults).

toggle.description: Dotted settings path of the master switch. Default: plugins.<id>.enabled.

settingsTab.description: Legacy: id of an existing shell settings tab.

host.description: Managed plugins only: QML host adapter path relative to the plugin UI root.

standalone.description: Managed plugins only: QML standalone entries (paths relative to the plugin UI root). dots generates a root-level launcher per entry so they run with the shell tree as the config root and can import the core kit.
